uncertainty.method: Exploratory percentile bootstrap over source/topic groups, 3000 resamples; not a guarantee on future sources or models.

protocol.selection: Choose among all valid evolved candidates and previous baseline using fixed reused calibration dev length-balanced objective; only new final test is independent.
protocol.support_exclusion: All original and added reference source groups excluded from scored train/dev.
protocol.warning: Round4 test has been promoted to calibration. Historical calibration dev is not an independent generalization estimate.
protocol.source_change_reason: Insufficient unused short government/review documents. Source choice made before teacher labeling or classifier evaluation; news and practical human prose extend scenario coverage.
protocol.budget: same cumulative $100 per provider; no reset

dev_extension.reason: Original calibration dev had only one positive in 25–49 tokens. Twelve fixed generation jobs across six models and two new topics were specified before any dev scoring; both returned classes are retained.

criteria.objective: Imitate Pangram binary labels on new English documents and generator topics
criteria.interpretation: Operational point-estimate targets on a fresh grouped test, not proof of universal equivalence or true-authorship accuracy. Report uncertainty and limited group counts.

repeatability.selection: First hash per available class in each <200-token bucket; not based on correctness. Diagnostic only.

expanded/selection.json.criterion: fixed reused source-group-disjoint calibration dev objective; no fresh labels or outcomes

expanded/protocol.json.rule: All former 86 calibration-dev cases are now learning data. Historical train cases may be reallocated by entire source group to ensure adequate positive coverage in the new calibration dev. Fixed reference groups excluded from both.
expanded/protocol.json.warning: These are historical calibration data; only the untouched 142 final texts are independent. Do not compare percentages across changed calibration splits.
expanded/protocol.json.selection: new calibration dev length-balanced objective; require gain >=0.005, and no regression in agreement/BA versus previous working prompt
